-- KY Senate: Charles Booker wins D primary — set as candidate2
UPDATE senate_races
SET candidate2_name = 'Charles Booker',
    candidate2_party = 'D',
    notes = 'Open seat — Mitch McConnell (R) retiring after 40 years. Andy Barr (R, Trump-endorsed) defeated Daniel Cameron and others. Charles Booker (D) defeated Amy McGrath. Kentucky is R+26; rated Solid R by all outlets.'
WHERE state_code = 'KY';

-- GA Governor: Keisha Lance Bottoms wins D primary — update status and notes
UPDATE governor_races
SET dem_candidate = 'Keisha Lance Bottoms',
    status = 'Primary Runoff',
    notes = 'D nominee: Keisha Lance Bottoms (former Atlanta Mayor) won D primary. R primary runoff (July 2026): Burt Jones (Trump-endorsed Lt. Gov.) vs. Rick Jackson (MAGA billionaire) — Raffensperger eliminated. Winner faces Bottoms in November.'
WHERE state_code = 'GA';

-- GA-12: Fix duplicate candidate2 = Rick Allen (uncontested R race)
UPDATE house_races
SET candidate2_name = NULL,
    candidate2_party = NULL
WHERE state_code = 'GA' AND district = 12 AND candidate2_name = 'Rick W. Allen';
